data: Ženska priča iz muške perspektive o dvoje gubitnika koji su izmislili učinkovitu metodu samopomoći pod "sloganom": "Ljubav do neba, jebanje do zvijezda" te se nađu u vrtlogu seksa, politike, religije, medija, razorne moći uma kulture slavnih, striptiz likova i sudskih skandala. (The death of his mother brings Richie Bravo back from his adopted home in Italy to his teenage bedroom in Lower Austria, where Charlton Heston is still flexing his biceps and Winnetou is still alive.)

Ženska priča iz muške perspektive o dvoje gubitnika koji su izmislili učinkovitu metodu samopomoći pod "sloganom": "Ljubav do neba, jebanje do zvijezda" te se nađu u vrtlogu seksa, politike, religije, medija, razorne moći uma kulture slavnih, striptiz likova i sudskih skandala.
The death of his mother brings Richie Bravo back from his adopted home in Italy to his teenage bedroom in Lower Austria, where Charlton Heston is still flexing his biceps and Winnetou is still alive.
